bootstrap testing non-CN API endpoint

```{r}

data <- read.csv('non-cn-bootstrap.csv', header = TRUE)

# Name the columns
colnames(data) <- c("Generation", "round", "count")

# Make sure round and count are numeric
data$round <- as.numeric(data$round)
data$count <- as.numeric(data$count)

scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma())


# Plot
ggplot(data, aes(x = round, y = count, color = Generation)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(title = "Count over Rounds by Tech",
       x = "Round",
       y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

```

# protocol counts by day

```{r}

# Helper to load a file and add a generation label
read_with_generation <- function(filename, generation_label) {
  df <- read.csv(filename, header = FALSE, col.names = c("Count", "Date"))
  df$Date <- as.Date(df$Date)
  df$Count <- as.numeric(df$Count)
  df$Generation <- generation_label
  return(df)
}

# Read and label each file
df1 <- read_with_generation("all-by-day.csv", "All")
df2 <- read_with_generation("nr-by-day.csv", "NR")
df3 <- read_with_generation("lte-by-day.csv", "LTE")
df4 <- read_with_generation("gsm-by-day.csv", "GSM/UMTS")

# Combine all into one data.frame
all_data <- rbind(df1, df2, df3, df4)

scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma())


# Plot
ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Date, y = Count, color=Generation)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = "Date",
       y = "Base Stations") +
  theme_minimal()
```

cumulative number of gsm-umts/lte/nr towers seen

```{r}
# Helper to load a file and add a generation label
read_with_generation <- function(filename, generation_label) {
  df <- read.csv(filename, header = FALSE, col.names = c("Count", "Date"))
  df$Date <- as.Date(df$Date)
  df$Count <- as.numeric(df$Count)
  df$Generation <- generation_label
  return(df)
}

# Read and label each file
df1 <- read_with_generation("cumulative-all.csv", "All")
df2 <- read_with_generation("cumulative-nr.csv", "NR")
df3 <- read_with_generation("cumulative-lte.csv", "LTE")
df4 <- read_with_generation("cumulative-gsm.csv", "GSM/UMTS")

# Combine all into one data.frame
all_data <- rbind(df1, df2, df3, df4)

scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma())


# Plot
ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Date, y = Count, color=Generation)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = "Date",
       y = "Cells",
       color = "Technology"
       ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("cumulative-tech.png", bg="white")
ggsave("cumulative-tech.pdf")
```
